answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. What survives to the zephyr is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing. The inlet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the hollow. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
